title: Gakuen Prince
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Elite Joshi High goes coed, and with girls far outnumbering boys, the girls compete aggressively for the few new male students. Transfer student Azusa Mizutani picks Rise Okitsu as a pretend girlfriend to shield himself, and Rise is then tormented by jealous classmates. Kodansha rates it 16+.
life_message: A good life means keeping your head and independence in a crowd driven by desire and status, until real feeling grows.

content.note: Rise is tormented by jealous classmates (Publishers Weekly 'torture'; AniList and MangaUpdates Bullying). MangaUpdates also tags attempted rape (19 votes), unconfirmed by a second kind of source.
